data.name: Khatera
data.gender_notes: Khatera is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'kh-t-r', meaning 'to remember, recall, or preserve'. In Islamic tradition, the name Khatera is believed to evoke the traits of a wise and trustworthy individual who holds knowledge and wisdom dear. The name Khatera carries the meaning “Memory, Recall” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khatera usually hope their child will grow to embody memory, recall and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khatera total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
